stem:
The list shows the length of a day on two different planets.

• Neptune: 16.11 hours
• Venus: 5,832.40 hours

Which statement is best supported by this information?

options.label: A
options.text: A day on Venus is about 40 times as long as a day on Neptune.

options.label: B
options.text: A day on Venus is about 400 times as long as a day on Neptune.

options.label: C
options.text: A day on Venus is about 50 times as long as a day on Neptune.

options.label: D
options.text: A day on Venus is about 500 times as long as a day on Neptune.

visual_elements: bullet points listing planet day lengths
